CoordinatorServiceImpl - Class in com.example.inelasticsearch.coordinator
Speaks the same DataNodeService contract as a data node but never touches Lucene: it routes IndexDocument to the single node that owns the target shard, and scatters Search to every node in parallel, merging whatever hits come back (scatter-gather).

DataNodeServiceImpl(Path, int) - Constructor for class com.example.inelasticsearch.grpc.DataNodeServiceImpl
Single-node mode: this instance owns every shard of every index.
DataNodeServiceImpl(Path, int, Set<Integer>) - Constructor for class com.example.inelasticsearch.grpc.DataNodeServiceImpl
Multi-node mode: this instance only owns ownedShards, the rest live elsewhere.
DataNodeServiceImpl(Path, ClusterTopology, String) - Constructor for class com.example.inelasticsearch.grpc.DataNodeServiceImpl
Multi-node mode with replication: this instance stores every shard it owns as primary or replica (allShardsOwnedBy(java.lang.String)), and asynchronously pushes writes for its primary shards out to their replica nodes.
